title: The rupee’s record slide in 2026
dek: From near 89 to the dollar in January to above 96 by May. Why the rupee became Asia’s worst-performing currency this year.
seoTitle: Rupee vs dollar 2026 timeline: every record low and why

glance.what: The rupee has lost close to 8% against the dollar in 2026, setting record lows again and again.
glance.why: A weaker rupee makes imports like oil, electronics and foreign travel or education more expensive, and adds to inflation.
glance.next: Watch oil prices and foreign investor flows. The RBI has been selling dollars to slow the fall rather than defend a level.

forYou: Anything priced in dollars costs more: foreign trips, overseas tuition, imported gadgets. Families receiving money from abroad get more rupees per dollar or dirham.
next: Watch oil prices and foreign investor flows.

events.title: First record low of the year
events.summary: The rupee weakens toward 91.7 per dollar as foreign investors sell Indian stocks.

events.title: Past 92 as war in West Asia lifts oil
events.summary: Soaring oil prices and fighting in the Gulf push the rupee past 92 for the first time.

events.title: A lifetime low of 93.96
events.summary: Global uncertainty drives the rupee to a new record.

events.title: Through 96 as oil surges
events.summary: The rupee hits 96.25 in early trade after closing below 96 for the first time the previous Friday. Foreign investors pulled nearly $20 billion from Indian equities in the first four months of 2026.

events.title: Hovering near record lows ahead of the RBI decision
events.summary: The rupee trades around 96.4 per dollar. The RBI keeps selling dollars to slow the fall, and markets price in a rate hike.
